summary.background: The purpose of this study is to estimate regional economic effects of spatial diffusion of wildfire using Cobb-Douglas production function of agriculture and forestry.
summary.method: The models of wildfire provides that the spatial diffusion of wildfire increases with the rising of highest temperature and average wind speed.
